messages:
taylor_pm: FYI — Sales flagged a contract ask from VertexAI Corp for contractual 99.99% uptime + 50ms p95 latency for text-generation endpoint. They want committed SLA in 6 weeks. Details below.

jess_support: Copy. Customer reported intermittent 503s during peak. They've asked for SLA addendum.

leah_sales: Revenue: ~$180k ARR, onboarding M-2. Contract deadline 2026-04-10. Customer will only sign with SLA + 24/7 P1 support.

alex_engineering: 50ms p95 across what model size / region? We currently target 100ms p95 for hosted m1-medium in eu-west. Needs quantify.

taylor_pm: Good q — request says "<model: redwood-rlhf-13B>, europe region, sustained qps 100". I pasted the contract snippet in the thread.

sanjay_infra: Quick reality check: for 13B at sustained QPS 100 we need Dedicated pools + aggressive batching. 99.99% is doable but operational work: autoscaler tuning, regional redundancy, and warm standby. Rough estimate 4-6 wks eng + infra.

maria_product: Can we run a gating checklist? Proposed acceptance criteria:
- 99.99% uptime measured monthly
- p95 <= 50ms for 95% of traffic in region
- documented fallback to smaller model within 200ms
- test harness + synthetic load validation

jess_support: I'll open the intake ticket and tag p1-sla. Intake form link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/SLD-104 (use that)

alex_engineering: Proposal: implement model variant routing + local KV cache warmup. If autoscaling lags, route to cheaper but faster quantized model. Fallback policy:
```
if latency > 50ms or queue_length > 8:
  route -> redwood-13b-quant
  notify -> #eng-oncall
```

sanjay_infra: Ops notes:
- Need HA across 2 AZs in eu-west
- Reserve Dedicated nodes (estimate 8 gpus)
- Update monitoring and SLO alerts: p99, p95, error-rate

leah_sales: Can we scope a minimal contract deliverable to get them to sign now and then commit to full SLA later? They need something in the doc asap.

taylor_pm: Yes. Suggested two-step: (1) interim commitment — 99.9% + 8hr business hours P1 for the first 90 days; (2) full 99.99% + 24/7 after validation and Dedicated capacity. We'll add rollout criteria.

maria_product: I'll add this to next prioritization sync. Need engineering estimate (san say 4-6wks). If so, we can timeboxed to Q2 roadmap. Also need legal + security signoff for contract.

jess_support: Intake ticket created: SLD-4219. I've linked contract and customer logs.

taylor_pm: Next steps: @alex_engineering to draft fallback policy + perf targets by EOD tomorrow. @sanjay_infra to post capacity estimate + can-we-deliver checklist by Friday. @leah_sales prepare customer comms for interim proposal. I'll slot this into roadmap grooming on Thursday.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Mentioned users added to incident rotation: alex_engineering, sanjay_infra

leah_sales: Ack :thumbsup:  

alex_engineering: Will do. Starting a PR for routing config in infra repo.

taylor_pm: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread updated.
